stateController.notes: MyMembershipsScreen resolves the current uid, combines the owner-readable membership and benefit-use streams into rows with savings, and routes pause, resume and cancel-at-period-end through MyMembershipsController after a confirm dialog. Billing status is server-owned; the screen only renders it.
